metadata.title: Palo Alto Networks shares dip after earnings, and other early market movers. - MarketWatch

content.text:
June 3, 4:46am ET
Palo Alto Networks shares dip after earnings, and other early market movers.
Here are some of the stocks making notable moves in Thursday's premarket action:
Palo Alto Network shares are slipping nearly 4% after the cybersecurity group's strong earnings report coincided with some profit-taking in a stock that had jumped 62% in just the past month.
GameStop shares are jumping 8% after the videogame retailer's board said it had approved a $2 billion stock buyback program.
GitLab shares are down 4% after the maker of software development tools posted reduced losses and said it would shed 14% of its workforce as part of an AI pivot.
Shares of Ollie's Bargain Outlet are up more than 4% ahead of the retailer's earnings that are due before the market open.
